reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding*

• *[P1] Overlapping contacts aren’t deduped by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2` uses `Set`, which compares objects by reference, not `id`. Separate imports produce separate objects, so `mergeImports([{id: 1}], [{id: 1}])` returns two contacts instead of one, violating the README’s first-seen contract.
  *Recommended fix:* Track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add a regression test with distinct objects sharing an ID, including across two import lists.

*Verification:* All 4 existing tests pass; a direct overlapping-import reproduction returns both duplicates. The tests in `test/dedupe.test.js` cover repeated references and different IDs, but not separate objects with the same ID.

No other findings. No files changed.
